Doug, saw RigUp is pushing into renewables, midstream, and downstream and hiring across Austin and Denver.

Expanding into new energy segments usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before the new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for RigUp off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Doug, quick follow-up for RigUp.

Moving into new segments usually means board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late, and by then it is a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings RigUp needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
